fields.text: Threat model drafted (STRIDE methodology)
fields.guidance: Identify spoofing, tampering, repudiation, information disclosure, DoS, and elevation of privilege threats.

fields.text: Security requirements documented and scoped
fields.guidance: Define non-functional security requirements, security controls, and acceptance criteria.

fields.text: Data classification and privacy requirements defined
fields.guidance: Categorise sensitive data (PII, credentials, payment data) and legal retention limits.

fields.text: Authentication and authorization requirements stated
fields.guidance: State role definitions, password complexity policy, MFA requirements, and session rules.

fields.text: Regulatory and compliance obligations identified
fields.guidance: Identify applicable regulations (e.g. GDPR, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001) if applicable.

fields.text: Architecture diagram reviewed with security team
fields.guidance: Produce and review high-level and component diagrams showing networks, services, and datastores.

fields.text: Trust boundaries and data flows identified
fields.guidance: Map untrusted client inputs and inter-service boundaries across the architecture.

fields.text: Attack surface enumerated and minimized
fields.guidance: Catalog exposed ports, public APIs, third-party endpoints, and administrative interfaces.

fields.text: Authentication and session management design reviewed
fields.guidance: Confirm secure cookie flags (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite), CSRF defense, and session expiry.

fields.text: Input validation and sanitization strategy defined
fields.guidance: Specify allowlist validation patterns, type constraints, and schema enforcement.

fields.text: Secrets management approach chosen and documented
fields.guidance: Ensure secrets are kept in environment variables or key vaults, never checked into VCS.

fields.text: Input validation enforced on all user-controlled data
fields.guidance: Verify all form inputs, query params, headers, and payloads are strongly validated server-side.

fields.text: Output encoding used in templates to prevent XSS
fields.guidance: Ensure framework auto-escaping is active; verify no unsanitized raw HTML or safe filters on user inputs.

fields.text: Parameterized queries or ORM used exclusively (no raw SQL)
fields.guidance: Confirm no raw string concatenation in database queries to prevent SQL injection.

fields.text: No hardcoded secrets, keys, or passwords in codebase
fields.guidance: Scan repository with automated secret scanners or git log inspection.

fields.text: Third-party dependencies scanned for known vulnerabilities
fields.guidance: Run pip-audit, safety, or dependabot to ensure all packages have no active CVEs.

fields.text: Error handling does not leak stack traces or internal info
fields.guidance: Custom 404/500 handlers configured; stack traces suppressed in user-facing responses.

fields.text: Access control checks enforced on every endpoint
fields.guidance: Verify authentication and authorization decorators/mixins are applied to all views.

fields.text: DAST scan run against a registered target
fields.guidance: Run OWASP ZAP spider and active scan against staging/local environment.

fields.text: OWASP Top 10 checklist completed for current release
fields.guidance: Verify each of the 2021 Top 10 risk areas has been assessed for this application.

fields.text: Manual penetration test cases executed for AuthN and AuthZ
fields.guidance: Test privilege escalation, IDOR, brute-force limits, session fixation, and token reuse.

fields.text: Security findings triaged and logged with CVSS scores
fields.guidance: Record all vulnerabilities discovered, calculate CVSS vectors, and assign to developers.

fields.text: Regression tests verified for resolved security issues
fields.guidance: Confirm pentester re-test verification has passed for all fixed defects.

fields.text: Django deployment security checklist (manage.py check --deploy) passes
fields.guidance: Run `python manage.py check --deploy` and confirm zero critical security warnings.

fields.text: DEBUG disabled in production configuration
fields.guidance: Confirm settings.DEBUG = False and proper ALLOWED_HOSTS are configured.

fields.text: Production secrets provided exclusively via environment variables
fields.guidance: Verify SECRET_KEY and DB credentials are not in settings files or repositories.

fields.text: HTTPS enforced and HSTS / secure cookie flags active
fields.guidance: SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT, SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE, CSRF_COOKIE_SECURE enabled.

fields.text: HTTP Security Headers configured (CSP, X-Frame-Options, etc.)
fields.guidance: Configure Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy.

fields.text: Least-privilege database user configured
fields.guidance: Database account restricted to DML only; no superuser or DROP table permissions in production.

fields.text: Automated backups configured and recovery plan tested
fields.guidance: Verify database backup schedules and practice restore procedures.

fields.text: Security monitoring and centralized audit logging enabled
fields.guidance: Ensure authentication failures, role changes, and gate actions are logged to a tamper-resistant store.

fields.text: Periodic re-test scheduled (due dates set on open findings)
fields.guidance: Set explicit due_date values for any deferred low/medium vulnerabilities.

fields.text: Security patching and vulnerability management process documented
fields.guidance: Establish SLAs for patch application based on CVSS severity.

fields.text: Incident response plan and emergency security contacts recorded
fields.guidance: Document escalation contacts, severity levels, and communication channels.
